title: PS5 Linux lead quits: "a bunch of noobs using LLMs" that "they don't understand"
summary: The lead developer of the PS5 Linux project has resigned, citing frustration that open-source projects are increasingly populated by inexperienced contributors who rely on LLM-generated code they do not understand. The Hacker News discussion (318 points, 219 comments) debates the impact of AI coding assistants on open-source quality, maintainer burnout, and whether LLM-assisted contributions lower the bar for participation.
